models_evaluated: state-of-the-art LLMs (specific models not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM redirection of false-premise patient health questions compared with clinician responses
links.effect: LLMs often fail to redirect problematic questions, even when the problematic premise is detected, and give answers that could lead to suboptimal medical decision making.
links.quote: Our analysis reveals that LLMs often fail to redirect problematic questions, even when the problematic premise is detected, and provide answers that could lead to suboptimal medical decision making.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM safety and response capability (redirection of false premises) on a benchmark dataset (MedRedFlag) derived from Reddit medical questions, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
